method: Downloaded with curl; host-aware delay of at least 1.15 seconds between requests, exponential retry backoff on 429/5xx. Search also used web search/image index discovery. Source photos/renders/scans manually reviewed. Pillow/numpy perspective correction and Lanczos resizing; no generative reconstruction, repainting, watermark removal, or invented embossing.
interpretation: official means a verified G2 SteelBook for the selected game/edition, not the existence of any differently shaped package in the franchise. False is a documented research result, not proof of universal absence. Finish is visually inferred; fallback matte is a display default. Output resolution is distinct from native sampled detail; small sources are explicitly recorded. Photos retain tray hardware, wear, glare and source watermarks where disclosed.
